forecasts.question: Will Iran formally confirm a schedule for IAEA inspector access to at least one named nuclear facility before EOD 2026-07-05?

forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Iranian MFA, Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf, or senior Iranian official publicly confirms a specific scheduled date for IAEA inspector access at any named nuclear facility before EOD 2026-07-05, OR if IAEA Secretariat announces confirmed Iranian-cooperation inspection with named facility and date.

Trump/Vance claiming Iranian agreement without Iranian or IAEA Secretariat corroboration = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

Ambiguity rule's 'Trump-only assertions' exclusion does not apply; Pakistani PM Sharif is a named mediator independent of Trump. Judge overrode Source B's RESOLVE-NO (which conflated the June 17 formal ceremony with the prior June 14 digital execution).
